title: Schedule Type Editor period picker reworked: grouped and using styled toggles
summary: The period picker is now split into two collapsible groups -- Classes (Period 1-8 plus Advisory) and Custom (Lunch, Assembly, and anything genuinely custom) -- instead of one long flat list that was easy to get lost in.
Checkboxes replaced with the app's own styled sliding toggle switches, matching every other setting in the app instead of a native browser checkbox.
